# TDPdf v1.23.3.0

**Fixes Insert Text Box still appearing to do nothing for one user after 1.23.2.0.**

Production reporting confirmed that the affected machine had received 1.23.2.0 and no longer crashed. It also showed the remaining problem precisely: thirteen text editors reached Windows' loaded state in a few seconds, but none became usable.

The live editor previously shared the same canvas as permanent annotations. That canvas is rebuilt whenever the page's annotations and PDF overlays refresh, so a newly loaded editor could be removed before the user saw it. Text editors now have a separate topmost layer that page rendering never clears. TDPdf also waits until the creating mouse event has finished before assigning keyboard focus, and applies that focus handling consistently to both new text boxes and edits to existing PDF text.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.23.3.0, so managed machines pick this up on the next evaluation. Assignments are unaffected.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to confirm the download independently.
